reason: The repository provides a static DSH overlay and integration guide for an agent browser-control tool, including navigation, page interaction, text extraction, and screenshots; runtime compatibility is unverified because the referenced package was unavailable.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供浏览器控制配置与使用指南，支持网页导航、元素交互、文本提取和截图。
summaries.en: Provides DSH configuration and guidance for agent browser control, including web navigation, element interaction, text extraction, and screenshots.

capabilities: Interact with web page elements using CSS selectors
Capture screenshots to a configured directory
Open, list, and close browser pages
